In Lakeview, Vanier and the south-shore streets, it’s estate cleanouts in the small solid wartime and GM-era homes built by people who worked for a living — decades of a family’s belongings sorted with patience. Around downtown, O’Neill and McLaughlin, it’s estate and downsizing cleanouts in century and postwar homes alike. Through Eastdale, Donevan and Pinecrest, it’s garage, basement and moving cleanouts for established family streets. Near Ontario Tech and Durham College in Samac, it’s the city’s steadiest job: student rental turnovers, cleared between leases every May and September. And out toward Windfields, Kedron and the rural north, it’s newer-home moving cleanouts and farmhouse cleanouts on the concessions beyond. The 660+ five-star Google reviews behind Live Junk Free come from every one of those addresses — flat written quotes, care for belongings that took a working life to gather, and turnovers that never slip a lease.

blocks.text: CLEANOUT FAQ
Cleanout Services in Oshawa — Asked Straight, Answered Straight

items.q: What types of cleanout services do you offer in Oshawa?
a: We provide complete cleanout services for houses, apartments, condos, garages, basements, attics, storage units, offices, rental properties, and estates. Whether you’re moving, renovating, downsizing, or clearing an inherited property, we can handle the job.

items.q: Do I need to move items before your team arrives?
a: No. You don’t need to lift, sort, or move anything. Our crew removes items directly from where they are located, including upper floors, basements, garages, and backyards.

items.q: Can you remove large or heavy items?
a: Yes. We safely remove bulky furniture, appliances, mattresses, exercise equipment, office furniture, renovation debris, and other oversized items. Our team handles all the lifting, loading, and hauling.

items.q: How quickly can you complete a cleanout in Oshawa?
a: Most residential cleanouts are completed in a single visit. Smaller jobs may take only a few hours, while larger homes, estates, or commercial properties may require a full day. Same-day or next-day service may be available.

items.q: What happens to the items after they're removed?
a: We aim to reduce landfill waste by donating usable items, recycling eligible materials, and disposing of the remaining waste responsibly. Our goal is to provide an efficient and eco-friendly cleanout service throughout Oshawa.
